description: Traffic Speed Studies (Historical) is a dataset listed in City of Cambridge open data portal (data.cambridgema.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Cambridge. The Traffic, Parking &Transportation department has conducted over 600 speed studies since 1987. Some locations have been studied more than once. The speed of each passing vehicle is recorded by radar for an hour each in the morning rush hour, evening rush hour, and midday. Coverage: Cambridge, Massachusetts. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are motor vehicles, health and safety, vision zero, traffic. The table has 18 columns. Attribution on the portal: Traffic, Parking &Transportation department. The portal shows 2024-07-24 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cambridgema-gov-portal.
